comment: PocketPC3630 import knowledge base, layered on top of the cases compiled into the importer (download zips, self-extracting archives, installers that hold cabinets). Known lists exact downloads and the steps that take their game out. Rules say how to get a Pocket PC game out of a download that does not import as it is; ranking says which of several builds to take; problems explain what still fails. A file named import_kb.json in the library root is read too: its entries go first, and games that only imported after exploring add a learned rule there. See docs/PACKAGE_FORMAT.md.

ranking.comment: Scores add up over a candidate's path and its executable. Candidates are tried best first; one at -150 or below is never imported, so builds for other processors (-100) are only taken when no ARM build is there.

title.en: This is a .NET Compact Framework program, which PocketPC3630 cannot run.
title.zh-Hant: 這是 .NET Compact Framework 程式，PocketPC3630 目前無法執行。

hint.en: Look for a native ARM version of this program.
hint.zh-Hant: 請改找這個程式的原生 ARM 版本。

title.en: The game uses an instruction PocketPC3630 does not handle yet.
title.zh-Hant: 遊戲用到 PocketPC3630 尚未支援的指令。

hint.en: MIPS16 code in MIPS builds and floating-point instructions in SH4 builds are not supported yet; try the ARM build if there is one. Otherwise please report it with the details below.
hint.zh-Hant: 目前還不支援 MIPS 版的 MIPS16 壓縮指令，以及 SH4 版的浮點指令，請改用 ARM 版（如果有）。否則歡迎附上下方的技術細節回報。

title.en: The game needs a file that comes with the Pocket PC itself.
title.zh-Hant: 遊戲需要 Pocket PC 系統內建的檔案。

hint.en: Missing: {missing}. Put your own copy in the package next to the .cab.
hint.zh-Hant: 缺少：{missing}。請把你自己的副本放進遊戲包，和 .cab 放在同一層。

title.en: The game needs a file that is not in the package.
title.zh-Hant: 遊戲需要的檔案不在遊戲包裡。

hint.en: Missing: {missing}. Put it in the package next to the .cab or the game's .exe.
hint.zh-Hant: 缺少：{missing}。請把它放進遊戲包，和 .cab 或遊戲的 .exe 放在同一層。

title.en: This build is for a SuperH processor PocketPC3630 does not run (such as SH-3E or SH-5).
title.zh-Hant: 這是給 PocketPC3630 不支援的 SuperH 處理器（例如 SH-3E、SH-5）的版本。

hint.en: Import the ARM, MIPS or SH3 build instead. PocketPC3630 runs ARM (StrongARM, XScale/PXA, Samsung S3C, TI OMAP), MIPS (Casio Cassiopeia) and SH3 (HP Jornada 54x) builds.
hint.zh-Hant: 請改匯入 ARM、MIPS 或 SH3 版。PocketPC3630 可執行 ARM（StrongARM、XScale/PXA、Samsung S3C、TI OMAP）、MIPS（Casio Cassiopeia）與 SH3（HP Jornada 54x）版本。

match: executes arm and mips wince images only
executes native arm/mips wince images only

title.en: This is a desktop Windows program, not a Pocket PC one.
title.zh-Hant: 這是 Windows 桌面程式，不是 Pocket PC 程式。

hint.en: Do not run it. If it is an installer, open it with 7-Zip, take out the ARM .cab and import that.
hint.zh-Hant: 不要執行它。如果是安裝程式，請用 7-Zip 打開，取出 ARM 版的 .cab 再匯入。

title.en: This is not a Pocket PC CAB, or it is damaged.
title.zh-Hant: 這不是 Pocket PC 的 CAB，或檔案已損毀。

hint.en: Download it again. A desktop installer's data1.cab cannot be used; look for the CAB named for ARM, StrongARM, PPC_2577 or Pocket PC.
hint.zh-Hant: 請重新下載。桌面安裝程式的 data1.cab 無法使用，請改找檔名含 ARM、StrongARM、PPC_2577 或 Pocket PC 的 CAB。

title.en: This is a desktop Windows program, and no Pocket PC game could be taken out of it.
title.zh-Hant: 這是 Windows 桌面程式，而且無法從中取出 Pocket PC 遊戲。

hint.en: Do not run it. If it is an installer, open it with 7-Zip, take out the ARM .cab and import that.
hint.zh-Hant: 不要執行它。如果是安裝程式，請用 7-Zip 打開，取出 ARM 版的 .cab 再匯入。

title.en: This is a support library (DLL), not the game.
title.zh-Hant: 這是支援程式庫（DLL），不是遊戲本體。

hint.en: Import the game's .exe or its .cab; DLLs beside it are found automatically.
hint.zh-Hant: 請匯入遊戲的 .exe 或 .cab，同資料夾的 DLL 會自動載入。

title.en: No Pocket PC program was found in it.
title.zh-Hant: 裡面找不到 Pocket PC 程式。

hint.en: A package needs a Pocket PC .cab, or a folder with the game's ARM .exe. See the package format.
hint.zh-Hant: 遊戲包需要一個 Pocket PC 的 .cab，或含有遊戲 ARM .exe 的資料夾。請參考打包格式。

title.en: There is not enough storage space.

hint.en: Remove games you no longer play, then try again.
hint.zh-Hant: 請刪除不再遊玩的遊戲後再試一次。

title.en: The archive is damaged or cannot be read.
title.zh-Hant: 壓縮檔已損毀或無法讀取。

hint.en: Download it again, or open it with 7-Zip and repack the files as a plain ZIP.
hint.zh-Hant: 請重新下載；或用 7-Zip 解開後，重新壓成一般的 ZIP。

title.en: The file name cannot be used to name the game.
title.zh-Hant: 無法用這個檔名替遊戲命名。

hint.en: Rename the file to include letters or numbers, then import it again.
hint.zh-Hant: 請把檔名改成含英文字母或數字，再匯入一次。

title.en: The game's program file cannot be loaded.
title.zh-Hant: 遊戲的程式檔無法載入。

hint.en: The program inside may be damaged or packed. Try another copy of the game.
hint.zh-Hant: 裡面的程式可能已損毀或被加殼，請換一份遊戲檔再試。

title.en: The game stopped on something the emulator cannot do yet.
title.zh-Hant: 遊戲用到模擬器尚未支援的功能而停止。

hint.en: This game is not supported yet. Please report it with the details below.
hint.zh-Hant: 這個遊戲目前尚未支援。歡迎附上下方的技術細節回報。

title.en: The file could not be read.

hint.en: Check that the file still exists and can be opened, then try again.
hint.zh-Hant: 請確認檔案還在且可以開啟，再試一次。

hint.en: Try again. If it keeps happening, report it with the details below.
hint.zh-Hant: 請再試一次；如果持續發生，請附上下方的技術細節回報。
